label: Ovi bf16 CROSS diagnostic, WSL x86 CPU: one interpreter holds the original and the converted Ovi decoders (both trees mounted in one container), one thread; findings only, no parity claim
question: do the original and converted Ovi decoders agree at bf16 inside one interpreter? if yes, the run divergence is process state
role: cross: one container, both trees, one thread; stages S0 (minimal) -> S1 (+ original pack) -> S2 (+ converted-site, converted pack)
outputs: CROSS_RESULT.json + raw decoder outputs; DIAGNOSIS.json (verdict CODE_OR_OBJECT / IMPORT_EFFECT_<stage> / PROCESS_STATE)

hardening.integrity: packet + six material trees before the role; CASE parsed from pinned bytes
hardening.comparator_inputs: O_NOFOLLOW copies, re-hashed right before the analyzer

cap.basis: two bf16 Ovi models resident (~0.6 GB each) plus both packs imported; expected ~2-3 GiB
